privacidad_titulo: Privacy Policy and Tax Data Processing
privacidad_desc: Your privacy and the professional confidentiality of your accounting information are our highest commitment. Learn how we protect your personal and tax data under Peruvian legislation.
marco_legal: Official statement in compliance with Law N° 29733 (Peruvian Personal Data Protection Law) and Supreme Decree N° 003-2013-JUS.
banco_desc: Data collected forms part of the personal data bank 'Clients and Tax Advisory Estudio Cusihuaman', under the legal custody and responsibility of CPA Lourdes Cusihuaman Gálvez with fiscal domicile in Jr. Dante 260, Surquillo, Lima.
finalidad_desc: The information provided (names, Tax ID/RUC, personal ID, fiscal address, SOL portal credentials, electronic invoices, payroll records, and bank statements) is used solely to compute and submit tax declarations before SUNAT, maintain SIRE electronic accounting books, manage PLAME payroll, and resolve tax audits.
consentimiento_desc: By hiring our accounting services or submitting information through our digital platforms, you grant free, prior, express, and informed consent for the confidential processing of your data strictly for tax and accounting purposes.
transferencia_titulo: 4. No Third-Party Commercial Transfer & Strict Secrecy
transferencia_desc: Estudio Cusihuaman guarantees that it does not sell, rent, or transfer personal or financial data to third parties for advertising purposes. Information is only submitted to public regulatory authorities mandated by law (SUNAT, MTPE, ESSALUD).
arco_titulo: 5. Exercise of ARCO Rights (Access, Rectification, Cancellation, Opposition)
arco_desc: As the data owner, you may exercise your statutory ARCO rights at any time to inspect stored data, correct errors, or request deletion of data that is not subject to mandatory statutory tax retention periods.
arco_plazos: Statutory response deadlines: 20 business days for Access and 10 business days for Rectification, Cancellation, or Opposition under Art. 55 of Supreme Decree N° 003-2013-JUS.
seguridad_desc: We apply strict technical encryption protocols. Our web management dashboard operates Local-First, managing session preferences within your local device browser to minimize cloud exposure.
